about.heroTitle: Connecting curious travelers with the soul of Morocco
about.heroSubtitle: MeetLocalGuide was built on a single belief: the best way to experience a place is through the eyes of someone who calls it home.
about.missionBody: We curate a marketplace of verified Moroccan guides — storytellers, chefs, trekkers, and artisans who share their world with visitors seeking authentic connections over scripted tours.
about.value1Body: Every guide completes an in-person verification before going live on the platform.
about.value2Body: Reviews come from verified bookings only. No fake ratings, ever.
about.value3Body: Cancel up to 48 hours before any experience for a full refund.
about.value4Body: No hidden fees. No surprise charges. The price you see is what you pay.
